ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validations), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISBLANK(NextStep) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Next Step is required when moving the Opportunity from Negotiation to Closed Won.
